Name: Brewable Vanilla Mushrooms
Author: Markentyy
Description:
Brewable Vanilla Mushrooms

Every vanilla mushroom can now go into a Keg and come out as juice.

Vanilla Stardew 1.6 explicitly excludes mushrooms from keg processing (any vegetable or positive-energy forage other than mushrooms -> juice). This lightweight Content Patcher pack lifts that exclusion with a single keg_juice context tag per item. No new machines, no scripts, no save edits.

Covered: Morel, Chanterelle, Common Mushroom, Red Mushroom, Purple Mushroom, Truffle, Magma Cap.

Details:
- Ferment time ~4 days (6000 min, vanilla keg time).
- Output is always normal quality (vanilla keg behavior), price = base x 2.25. Tip: ferment normal-quality mushrooms, sell starred ones raw.
- Truffle still works in the Oil Maker too - your choice: fast Truffle Oil (6h) or slow but pricier Truffle Juice (~4 days).
- Modded mushrooms intentionally out of scope(see Vanilla).

Requirements: Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.x, Content Patcher 2.x.
Multiplayer: every player needs the pack.
Install: unzip the [CP] Brewable Vanilla Mushrooms folder into Stardew Valley/Mods. To uninstall, delete it.
